question_text: If paid acquisition on Meta scales up and customer acquisition cost rises from ₹2,500 to ₹3,500, what cohort data proves your unit economics won't instantly turn negative?
answer: We rely heavily on merchant organic word-of-mouth and we feel confident our strong founder network will keep CAC down.

evaluation.reason: Confidence and unverified founder network claims do not constitute verifiable empirical acquisition data.
evaluation.followup: What was your blended CAC over the last 90 days specifically excluding friends-and-family referrals?
evaluation.missing_proof: Paid channel performance audit from Meta Ads Manager showing actual CPA

question_text: How can you claim no direct competitors when LimeChat and BiteSpeed have raised over $7M and offer direct WhatsApp catalog checkouts in India?
answer: LimeChat focuses primarily on funded D2C Shopify brands in metros. BolBot is built specifically for unorganized Tier 2/3 hardware and apparel wholesalers requiring voice notes in Hindi and cash-on-delivery tracking, where LimeChat has zero presence.

evaluation.reason: Founder successfully distinguished their non-metro wholesale ICP from competitors' metro D2C positioning with concrete structural differentiators.
